decisions.reason: The source requests design-system documentation and assets but does not change any approved landing-page visual choice.
Requesting one confirmed maximum content width does not establish a width value or change the existing responsive and breakpoint guidance.
The requested token sheet, font assets, and width documentation are owned by the design-token Requirement and do not change the handoff stack or objective.
The source does not alter the requirement for shared headers, footers, or dark treatment across website pages.
The design-token documentation request does not change the footer's page coverage or visual-theme requirement.
The source is scoped to the website design system and does not state that these tokens, font assets, or content-width rules apply to the console shell.
